description: Change delivery mode for a NEW publication (not a site, not a non-public HTML-format page). Requires owner token; optional expectedVersion = current hostingVersion. Mismatches are reported, not rejected: a stale version still applies, and OLD links or forced subdomain modes stay unchanged; the result then carries a delivery notice. Content updates never change hosting.

expectedVersion.description: Optional current hostingVersion from the server; a stale value still applies and the result says so

namespace.description: Resource namespace; non-public HTML-format pages stay on subdomain

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Resource type; sites always stay on their own subdomain

name: update_hosting
title: Change delivery mode
